response_contract.scientific_semantics: Live macOS HTTPS metadata response verified ImageServer scientific service, extent and pixel size. Provider lists daily-occurrence aggregates, not individual OT time/position detections. Preserve calendar/hour bins, coverage, nodata and exact units; never treat OT days as hail days. Rights for exact layer and image export not yet reviewed; no raster bytes sampled. On 2026-11-25 bounded macOS HTTPS exportImage request (bbox 10,47,12,49; bboxSR/imageSR 4326; size 64,64; format tiff; pixelType F32; f image) returned image/tiff, 66342 bytes, SHA-256 371ce0ec153e6529cf32924c378fccf72f8bf174ce16bc4f01bc169fda31f659, little-endian TIFF magic; actual variable/time slice and raster values not inspected. Earlier no-raster statement refers to prior run; this is a derived service export not original provider raster. Do not use scientifically until slice/units/rights confirmed.
